result_text:
I changed `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` so `all_files.zip` is built from the configured aspect names instead of fixed literals. I only compiled the `reports` module (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`, no errors). I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config.

The export now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects, in that order. It gets each entry name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is the same call that writes the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files. It then reads each file back under that name and puts it in the zip.

With the default config the entries stay `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` and `aspect_other.txt`, in that order. Renaming the aspect to "buildAndDeployment" should give `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in fourth place.

The old code threw when it couldn't find the hard-coded file, which skipped both zips. That no longer happens, so `git-history.zip` should be written too when `git-history.txt` exists.
